# MyIsn.iOS — Current State

**Snapshot date:** 2026-09-28
**Generated by:** /document-projects

## Tech stack
Swift/SwiftUI, single app target `Empower` (`Empower.xcodeproj`), min iOS 17 (app target; `StyleKit` subproject targets iOS 16). Xcode 26.3. SwiftLint enforced (auto-fixed on edit via a Claude Code hook). CI: Azure Pipelines, `nightlyVeracode.yml` (Veracode scan), SonarQube.

## Architecture
MVVM. Screens under `Empower/Screens/<Feature>/` follow a fixed split: `{Name}ViewModel.swift`, `{Name}ViewModel+Requests.swift` (always present), `{Name}ViewModel+Alerts.swift`, `Views/{Name}View.swift`. Navigation centralized in `Empower/Shared/Environment/Navigation/` (`NavigationState`, `AppRoute`, `AppRouteViewBuilder`). Targets: `Empower` (app), `EmpowerTests` (Swift Testing), `StyleKit` (local Xcode subproject framework, not an SPM package despite AGENTS.md calling it a "design system package"). No formal DI container — composition via `AppSession`/`AppSessionConfiguration`, built `.production`/`.nonProduction` in `AppDelegate`, constructor-injected.

## Key features/flows found
`Empower/Screens/`: App Update, Connection (Add ISN ID to Wallet, Company Details, Connection Removed/Status/Success, Connections Found, Enter ISN ID, ISN ID Recovery, Terms and Conditions), Geolocation, Hazard Assistant (Main/Details/Results/Review Description/Archived), ISN ID Card, Launch, Login and Onboarding (Welcome, Login B2C, Email Verification/Found, Profile Match, Account Reactivation, Biometrics), MyCompanies, Quick Check (Add/Details/Module/QR Reader/Share, Training Multilevel/Qualification), Tabs (Home, Documents, My Tools, Notifications, Profile, Training, ToolboxTalks), WAck (Workers Acknowledgement), Worker Forms. Dev-only: `Empower/Dev Sandbox/` (API Environment, Cache, Deeplinks, Feature Flags, Geolocation, Logs, Push Notifications — `#if !APPSTORE`).

## Networking / API layer
Hand-rolled `URLSession`-based `APIBackendService: ApiClient` (no Alamofire/Moya). `ApiEnvironment`: `remoteMock`/`development`/`staging`/`production` — dev/staging/prod base URLs from Firebase Remote Config; `remoteMock` URL user-editable in Dev Sandbox, defaults to `http://localhost:3000`. Auth via `RequestTokenProvider` wrapping MSAL (Azure AD B2C), injects `Authorization: Bearer` + an APIM subscription-key header (from generated `Keys.swift`) for authenticated requests; throws `ServiceError.needToLogin` on 401. ~90 endpoints in `Endpoint.swift` — see `docs/api-contracts.md` for the full domain breakdown. Service classes per feature under `Empower/Networking/Services/<Feature>/`.

## Third-party SDKs
firebase-ios-sdk (Analytics, Crashlytics, RemoteConfig, Performance), MSAL (Azure AD B2C), Pendo, Qualtrics, Radar SDK (geolocation), Nuke/NukeUI (images), Lottie (animations), JWTDecode, PhoneNumberKit, RSBarcodes (QR), SwiftMiniZip, Cache (generic caching), **Wormholy** (dev-only HTTP traffic inspector, `#if !APPSTORE`) — see `docs/observability.md` for the security note on Wormholy capturing auth headers.

## Testing
Swift Testing (XCTest forbidden for new files). Structure mirrors `Empower/` under `EmpowerTests/Unit Tests/`, plus `Doubles/Fixtures`, `Doubles/Spies`, `Mocks/`. Conventions: flat Arrange/Act/Assert, no shared test helpers, prefer `struct` suites. `Empower.xctestplan` covers `EmpowerTests` + `StyleKitTests` with code coverage enabled (non-parallelizable). `FB_REFERENCE_IMAGE_DIR`/`IMAGE_DIFF_DIR` env vars configured (snapshot-testing scaffolding) but no snapshot library dependency was found — worth double-checking if still in use.

## Known gaps
- Cache expiry headers not yet implemented (`CacheManager.swift`) — waiting on API team.
- A temporary debug-logging TODO tied to a version marker (`StandardWebView.swift`).
- A cross-platform analytics-strings parity gap tracked against work item `ISN-2303` (`AnalyticsStrings.swift`).
- A known backend workaround for acknowledgement-history date truncation (`AcknowledgementHistory.swift`).
- `DocumentImage.swift` uses `String` instead of `Data` for image data as a known shortcut.
- Notification navigation incomplete for some context types (`NotificationsListViewModel.swift`).
- `ds-migration` skill exists specifically because StyleKit component rollout across legacy call-sites is an active, ongoing effort — not yet complete.
- Secrets (`apimSubscriptionKey*`, `pendoKey`, `radarTestKey`/`radarLiveKey`) are base64-obfuscated in generated `Keys.swift`, not encrypted — worth a security review.
- PII/token logging risks (Wormholy capturing full HTTP traffic incl. auth headers in non-App-Store builds; push payload and analytics-event properties logged persistently) — see `docs/observability.md`.
